mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at the Military Ridge State Trail and a moderate air quality index of 53. The moon is in its third quarter phase, and our overnight low will be 62 degrees with no rain expected.

City updates today include an arrest by the Verona Police Department involving a school staff member for sexual assault of a child, as well as an update on the Highway M road construction where traffic shifts will continue through the month.

There is a lot going on this week, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for yoga at Insight Wellness on September 7, and trivia nights starting September 8 at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
The Verona Police Department reported an arrest stemming from an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred on Sunday, August 30, 2026.
You can enjoy today's delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day at our local Culver's, which is currently open and serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
